en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 170 points at 23041 after high open
en.dek: The index finished 0.73 per cent lower with turnover of HK$178.3 billion. HSBC shares fell more than 5 per cent after third-quarter results while tech and property stocks also weakened.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed down 170.49 points, or 0.73 per cent, at 23041.32 on Tuesday after opening higher.

The benchmark opened at 23260, rose as high as 23313, then turned lower and touched an intraday low of 22983 before recovering slightly. Turnover was HK$178.3 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.48 per cent to 3800.

HSBC shares dropped more than 5 per cent after the bank reported a 32 per cent rise in third-quarter pretax profit to US$9.6 billion, a result that matched expectations but saw revenue under pressure. Xiaomi fell more than 4 per cent and several property and new-energy vehicle stocks also declined, while Zhipu rose nearly 9 per cent.

zh.headline: 恒指收跌170點報23041點
zh.dek: 指數高開低走，全日成交約1783億元。滙控季績後挫逾5%，科技及內房股偏弱，智譜逆市升近9%。
body: 恒生指數周二收報23041.32點，跌170.49點或0.73%，高開後倒跌。
指數開市報23260點，曾升至23313點，其後回落，低見22983點。全日成交1783.5億港元。恒生科技指數跌1.48%報3800點。
滙豐控股中午公布第三季除稅前利潤增32%至96億美元，大致符合預期，但股價績後跌逾5%。小米跌逾4%，多隻內房及新能源車股偏弱，智譜則升近9%。
